title: Keyturn Host Protection Plan Underwriting Note: Prior Reporting and What a New Report Carries
content:
How often an enrolment on the Keyturn Host Protection Plan has been reported on before, and whether those earlier reports were completed, adds to the documentation a fresh damage report carries.

Where two or more damage reports have been lodged on the enrolment in the twelve months before and at least one of them was closed incomplete, the unfinished-reporting addition of 3 documents is added. Where two or more reports have been lodged in that period and none of them was closed incomplete, the frequent-reporting addition of 1 document is added. Where fewer than two reports have been lodged in that period, nothing is added on that account.

### Combinations

| Reports lodged in the twelve months before | At least one closed incomplete | Added |
|---|---|---|
| 2 or more | yes | 3 |
| 2 or more | no | 1 |
| fewer than 2 | either | nothing |

Two reports in the period is enough to pass the threshold; a single report in the period adds nothing whether or not it was closed incomplete.

### Where the reading is taken from

The reports counted are those lodged on the damage report register against this enrolment within the twelve months before the fresh report, and a report is closed incomplete where it was closed for want of the evidence it needed.
